brief: Reduce the permissible load by 8 percent of rating because one of three cooling fans has seized, and apply any further reductions required for high ambient temperature as outlined in MG-021. Where this ageing unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure in accordance with MG-023. Restore the full rating only when the underlying condition has been corrected and verified, as required by MG-021.
